entries.origin_analysis: The 2025 External-Gate Failure Postmortem showed that the rejected fixed Shock Failure candidate mixed a major loss class, F_CONTINUATION_RESUMPTION, with a profitable H_SUSTAINED_REVERSAL class. The user authorized a new independent hypothesis to test whether those paths could be distinguished using information available no later than the original entry decision boundary, without retuning B_EXECUTABLE_T0_8BAR or using 2025 for selection.
entries.causal_hypothesis: The strength and duration of the original shock, the quality of the completed failure, residual continuation pressure and completed higher-timeframe trend state may contain a portable pre-entry distinction between continuation resumption and sustained reversal.
target_failure_mode: Shock Failure continuation resumption after failure confirmation
winner damage from suppressing genuine sustained reversals
pre_result_predictions: Continuation-resumption losses and sustained-reversal profits will be present in the 2023H1-2024H2 development population under the same lifecycle definitions.
At least one small, explicit model may reject a material share of continuation-resumption loss while retaining at least 70% of sustained-reversal profit.
A portable candidate must show nonnegative net benefit in at least three of four folds and cannot rely on one side, one session or one event.
If OOF discrimination remains near chance or winner damage exceeds loser benefit, the correct decision is NO_PORTABLE_CANDIDATE.

tests.type: four-fold Raw Tick lifecycle reconstruction, timestamp audit, univariate separation, nested LOFO model selection, stress and concentration study

entries.decision: Close the frozen USDJPY-HYP-028 candidate catalog with NO_PORTABLE_CANDIDATE. The development lifecycle mechanism is real and is also visible in the consumed 2025 comparison, but the tested entry-time summaries cannot discriminate it portably. Do not implement any tested score in Core, do not run MT4 economics, and do not call 2025 a holdout.
retained_findings: The lifecycle reconstruction reproduced 114 opportunities with zero lookahead violations; three differences from the preserved historical approximation were recorded separately rather than overwritten.
F_CONTINUATION_RESUMPTION was negative in every development fold and totaled 37 events / -8171 JPY, while H_SUSTAINED_REVERSAL totaled 45 events / +19917 JPY.
The weak 2023H2 fold had the same central mechanism later seen in 2025: 15 continuation-resumption events / -2866 JPY versus 10 sustained reversals / +2168 JPY.
The only material univariate association was shock duration: H median two bars versus F median one bar, AUC 0.635, permutation p 0.024, with consistent direction across folds.
Tick imbalance, acceleration, retracement, failure body, failure close relative to shock origin and H1/H4 slopes were weak or near chance as standalone separators.
All three frozen models reduced continuation-resumption losses but removed more sustained-reversal winner profit, creating negative net benefit and poor fold breadth.
The best diagnostic tree retained only 67.93% of sustained-reversal profit, rejected 48.81% of continuation-resumption loss, had OOF AUC 0.515 and nonnegative benefit in only two folds.
2025H1/H2 were physically unavailable to the selection evaluator and were downloaded only after final_decision.json existed; the post-selection comparison contained exactly 47 consumed 2025 events.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: The tested finite catalog of simple pre-entry impulse, failure-quality, tick-pressure and higher-timeframe features can produce a portable Shock Failure permission filter.
Higher-timeframe EMA alignment alone materially separates continuation resumption from sustained reversal in this family.
Failure-window tick imbalance or acceleration provides stable classification across the four development folds.
A shallow tree's pooled profit factor improvement is evidence of portable economic improvement.
Removing approximately half of continuation-resumption losses necessarily improves the fixed candidate once sustained-reversal winner damage is counted.
prohibited_reuse: Do not convert the all-development RD_TREE_D2_V1 split into a candidate rule; it is diagnostic only and its LOFO split stability was 0.25.
Do not tune nearby thresholds, feature subsets or score weights from these outcomes without a materially new preregistration.
Do not use 2025 Short, London, month or event results to define a replacement rule.
Do not mix Profit Then Giveback exit optimization into this closed entry-discrimination hypothesis.
Do not implement in Core, run MT4 economics, authorize production, or reserve an external gate because no candidate was frozen.
Do not treat 2025H1/H2 as clean holdout evidence for any successor candidate.
successor_questions: Can a materially different ordered state-transition representation, rather than another threshold combination of summary features, identify genuine reversal establishment before entry?
Can a future independent hypothesis use native event sequences, market-state transitions or causal event context while preserving a strict timestamp contract and without reusing 2025 for selection?
Which completely unused 2026-or-later period can be reserved only after a successor candidate is preregistered and frozen before any access?
